svg.title: The queue is what turns 11 seconds into 25 milliseconds
svg.desc: Message queue diagram: a signup API writes the user row and publishes a user created event to a topic, returning in about twenty five milliseconds, while four independent consumers for email, thumbnails, CRM sync and analytics process the event at their own pace, so a CRM outage no longer breaks signup.
